## 2

I understand why some images can seem suspicious, especially when they’re edited or composited for clarity. But the evidence for a round Earth doesn’t depend only on photographs: satellite communications, time zones, changing stars, ships disappearing hull-first, lunar eclipses, and direct measurements all agree. Independent space agencies, companies, and researchers also produce consistent data, making a worldwide photo-faking conspiracy extraordinarily unlikely.

## 3

Sunlight looks white, but it contains many colors. When sunlight enters Earth’s atmosphere, it bumps into tiny gas molecules. Blue light gets scattered in all directions more strongly than most other colors, so blue light reaches our eyes from across the sky. At sunset, sunlight travels through more atmosphere; much of the blue scatters away, leaving more red and orange light.

## 4

雨落在深夜的城市里，像一层细密的帘子，把喧闹的街道隔在远处。路灯映在积水中，晕开一圈圈朦胧的金黄；偶尔驶过的汽车溅起水花，转眼又消失在巷口。窗玻璃蒙着薄雾，屋里只亮着一盏小灯。有人撑伞匆匆归家，有人倚在窗边听雨，任由时间在潮湿的空气里慢慢流淌。雨声轻轻敲打屋檐，仿佛夜晚正在低声诉说一个无人知晓的故事。
